description:
Set where one or more nodes go next. Pass multiple nodes in one call instead of separate tool calls.

- Linear: one rule with only target_node_id (A to B to C).
- By answer: on a single-select choice node with branching on, give one rule per answer with option_content set to the option's text, plus an optional default rule without option_content. Every answer needs a route: one with no rule of its own and no default has nowhere to go, and publishing fails. Different answers can go to different nodes or end screens. A multi-select choice has one route out, so answer rules are refused there.

Turning branching on: set config.choice.enable_branching: true in clipform_create_form, or with clipform_update_node. update_node replaces the whole choice object, so send the node's full current choice config from clipform_get_form with enable_branching added - a choice object with only enable_branching drops quiz settings such as record_scores.

A second ending that only some answers reach is added with clipform_add_node and unlinked: true.

A call replaces that node's routing entirely - it does not merge with any prior target. A default rule covers the answers that exist now; an answer added later needs its own rule. clipform_get_form shows each answer's route afterwards, and flags any answer with no route.

Example:
  nodes: [
    { node_id: "q1-id", rules: [{ target_node_id: "q2-id" }] },
    { node_id: "country-id", rules: [
      { option_content: "United Kingdom", target_node_id: "video-id" },
      { option_content: "Somewhere else", target_node_id: "sorry-end-id" }
    ] }
  ]

context.description: Describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence - not the tool you're calling.

form_id.description: The form UUID (returned by clipform_create_form, not the short share_id from the URL)

nodes.description: One or more nodes to set logic on

node_id.description: The node ID to set routing on

rules.description: One rule without option_content for a single next node, or one rule per answer (option_content) plus an optional default rule

option_content.description: Route only this answer: the option's text exactly as clipform_get_form lists it, without the (id: ...) suffix. Omit for the node's default route, which covers every current answer without a rule of its own.

target_node_id.description: The node ID this route goes to: any other node, including an end screen

name: clipform_set_logic

results.description: One result per node, in order

title: Set Node Logic
